JS102011SAQN
SWJS102011SAQN W/PA46WHITE ACT | Series: JS
Disclaimer Notice

Designers of telecommunication products, computer peripherals, thermostat select switches, and other various instrumentations need a switch that’s low-profile while still performing at a high level. The JS series sub-miniature slide switches feature positive detent, an IR reflow to 260º solder profile, surface and thru hole mounting – and are available in SPDT, DPDT and DP3T models.
